customers.evidence: We will walk in the shoes of people we serve and those with whom we work.

employees.evidence: collaboration with our colleagues and clients

dei.evidence: We will encourage the variety of thoughts and perspectives that reflect the diversity of our markets, customers and workforce.

community.evidence: We will then respond in service and advocacy for each individual, each group or community, and for society as a whole.

shareholders.evidence: We will be accountable and responsible for consistently delivering high quality and superior results that make a difference.

integrity.evidence: We will honor commitments. We will never compromise ethics.

innovation.evidence: pursue a course of continuous, positive and practical innovation as a core competency within our enterprise

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural 'We will' statements with absolute language ('never compromise ethics'). Integrity and innovation lead as headline values; compassion and relationships address people served and colleagues. Repeated slogans 'Help People Live Healthier Lives' and 'Make Health Care Work for Everyone'. Environment and safety are absent; financial language is minimal.
